findings.text: Snag 1 still needs a Servex restart to take effect (`Servex/agents/readme.md` "Sending to a VS Code tab" says so). `session.jsonl` answer 8 only promises that the 3-line report to vscode-mastermind will say it. Make sure that report goes out.

`review.mjs --shots-only` takes the shots from the worktree's own server only when the worktree has a `.worktrees.json` entry. Without one it shoots the MAIN site, and only a log line says so (`Server/review.mjs:785-792`). The doc paragraph in `Server/doc/review.md` (the one route for the gate's shots) should say that the worktree must be registered.

`--shots-only` also skips shooting when every `<width>.png` already exists (`Server/review.mjs:787`), so a hand-drawn PNG left in `shots/` is still accepted as real. The rule against hand-made shots is only in the docs.

The snag 4 proof (run-all `--browser` beside another headless job) is linked from the `proof` line in `session.jsonl` as whole files (`core/Test/results.jsonl`, `run-all.jsonl`), not as the specific run lines. Naming the run's `at` stamps would let a reader find them.
